reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

sourceIssues.basis: The text identifies a live cultural festival with dancing and activities. Actual Conversation audio has not been independently reviewed for third-party music/performance/background segments; presence or clearance is not assumed.
sourceIssues.resolution: Keep listening blocked until segment rights and spoken alignment are reviewed, or publish a separately versioned cleared excerpt with new hashes.

questions.prompt: Why is Anna writing to her friend at the beginning?
options: To ask for help with a work report.
To tell her about an enjoyable day.
answers: To tell her about an enjoyable day.
questions.evidence: Yesterday was the most amazing day. I want to tell my friend back home about it. So, I am writing her a letter!
questions.explanation: Anna开头说昨天很精彩，想把经历告诉家乡的朋友，所以写信。对话没有要求朋友帮写工作报告，也没有取消访问计划。so把写信的行为与分享昨天经历的目的联系起来。

spokenEvidence.quote: Yesterday was the most amazing day. I want to tell my friend back home about it. So, I am writing her a letter!

questions.prompt: Why did Anna start walking before she found the festival?
options: She wanted a break from work.
She was following a written festival map.
She was looking for a new office.
answers: She wanted a break from work.
questions.evidence: I was at work. And I wanted a break. So, I walked and walked … and walked.
questions.explanation: Anna的回顾旁白明确说当时在工作，想休息一下，因此出去走。后来偶然发现节日，不等于一开始就按地图去找活动；原文也没有找新办公室。这里按叙事先后区分出发原因与后来发现。

spokenEvidence.quote: I was at work. And I wanted a break. So, I walked and walked … and walked.

questions.prompt: What does the festival show each year?
options: Only one permanent exhibition of local offices.
questions.evidence: Every year the festival shows different cultures.
questions.explanation: 旁白直接说明节日每年展示不同文化。后面介绍的是那一年所呈现的一种文化，不能把单年的内容扩大为永久不变的全部展览，也不能把游戏活动缩减为只给职业运动员参加。

spokenEvidence.quote: Every year the festival shows different cultures.

questions.prompt: Which culture is featured in Anna’s account of that year’s festival? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: This year one of the cultures was the Basque culture.
questions.explanation: This year one of the cultures把范围限定在Anna所回顾的那一年，具体名称是Basque。只填一个名称词，不要加culture；原句也没有说整个节日只展示这一种文化。

spokenEvidence.quote: This year one of the cultures was the Basque culture.

questions.prompt: What activity does Anna say she took part in at the festival?
questions.evidence: At the festival, I danced a traditional Basque dance!
questions.explanation: Anna用I danced明确说自己参加了传统舞蹈。她也描述别人做饭、造船，但they与I指不同的动作实施者，不能把她看到的所有活动都算成她亲手完成。

spokenEvidence.quote: At the festival, I danced a traditional Basque dance!

questions.prompt: What is the name of the game played with hands and a small ball? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: They played a game with their hands and a small ball. It’s a kind of handball. But this game is called pilota.
questions.explanation: 旁白先说明用手和小球进行，再给出名称pilota。handball是游戏类别，pilota才是题目所要的具体名称。这个词在台词中实际说出，不依靠屏幕上的游戏标签或观看动作来回答。

spokenEvidence.quote: They played a game with their hands and a small ball. It’s a kind of handball. But this game is called pilota.
